entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane with a worldwide cityscape of grand halls, slums and ancient ruins, where ten guilds vie for power.

entities.name: The City of Ravnica
entities.description: A vast metropolis whose name has become synonymous with the entire plane, where the guilds vie for power.

entities.name: The Boros Legion
entities.description: The military red-white guild that believes righteousness is fire.

entities.name: The Izzet League
entities.description: The dragon-led blue-red guild fusing elemental magic and technology.

entities.name: The Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: The green-white guild honoring selflessness, nurturing and spiritual congregation.

entities.name: The Golgari Swarm
entities.description: The black-green death-worshiping guild controlling a vast undead army and labor force.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: The secretive blue-black guild of ghost stories, necromancer advisors and phantasmal assassins.

entities.name: The Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: The white-black guild, a rigid hierarchy of pomp and ritual, slaves to deals and coin.

entities.name: The Gruul Clans
entities.description: The red-green guild of beggars, gangs and raiding parties driven by base urges.

entities.name: The Azorius Senate
entities.description: The white-blue guild, primary lawmakers on Ravnica.

entities.name: The Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: The demon-led black-red guild delighting in thrill-killing and pleasure-seeking.

entities.name: The Simic Combine
entities.description: The green-blue guild of researchers who maintain and modify nature to survive.

entities.name: The Guildpact
entities.description: An ancient agreement that kept each guild's power in check, now dissolving.

events.summary: As the Guildpact dissolves through a mysterious outside threat, Ravnica descends into a cold war between the guilds.
events.quote: But as this agreement dissolves, thanks to the influence of a mysterious outside threat, Ravnica descends into a state of cold war between the Guilds.

relations.quote: the City of Ravnica, a metropolis so vast that its name has long since become synonymous with the entire plane.
in contrast to the demon-led Rakdos (black-red), who delight in thrill-killing and pleasure-seeking.
